phase9.note: Real PostgreSQL/Redis, fresh named volumes, healthy default core, deliberate dependency stop/restart and optional service absence; all 24 real service healthchecks checked in the maximum batch.

Active request/DB/queue deadlines and bounded payloads reviewed. Hono now rejects chunked oversize bodies; MinIO actively destroys timed-out sockets. HTTP assets also have server deadlines. Long-lived SSE/WebSocket use explicit bounded lifetimes, not ordinary request deadlines.

Finite waits/fake freeze/dialog depth, fixed-size scene pools and pagehide/AbortController/worker/RAF cleanup reviewed against actual sources and existing lifecycle acceptance. Ongoing decorative loops are user-authorized; no GPU benchmark or universal leak-free claim.

Fresh real JSON repeated submission/export/refresh/Back, denied storage, generated fictional entry and native keyboard exit passed. HTML-shaped input stays inert; original identity inputs never leave the page or persist. Earlier image/export/game acceptance is retained with its original scope; latest natural tower ascent/Boss win was not rerun.

IndexedDB open/transaction have three-second bounds and session-memory fallback; denied Cache Storage fetches the local CSV directly. Browser denied-storage save and stable exit actually passed; memory fallback is explicitly labeled and is not database evidence.

PG rows limited to 256, gateway memory to 64, replica/outbox/log tables bounded; Redis TTL/AOF, Rabbit queue limits and Kafka retention, rolled file/container logs. Real SQL/Redis stop-restart and maximum replica/reconciliation tests passed.

Meaningful unit, native browser, Cypress and six language integration frameworks exercised actual behavior. Linux fresh build passed 299 Vitest + 6 Node + 3 Jest. Native frameworks each passed two real-service assertions. Early failed attempts retained separately.
Windows/Linux/macOS CI matrix and independent Cypress job added. Workflow inspected; it has not run remotely because no GitHub publication was requested.

Actual local Git clone, fresh uncached Windows pnpm install, full build and standard dev; fresh Linux install/build/tests/dev; isolated Compose default core with fresh named volumes. No local cache/root variables are required by the public application.

Acceptance joins actual working tools, intentionally conflicting presentation, all backend groups and preserved dormant versions. It is a scoped acceptance, not a production-quality or every-device guarantee.
